{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id and total rows
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check distribution of arm and severity
tab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print("Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(tab_arm_severity)

# Check if any patient has multiple sample_seq
patient_sample_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(patient_sample_seq[patient_sample_seq > 1])}")"}
